dataset: Amergis public office directory: normalized detail records
normalization_notes: Location count is published content inventory, not a verified count of currently operating offices.
Address, phone and map conflicts are preserved; no candidate or personal records collected.
Map comparison checks explicit street-number differences only; most map links contain opaque IDs and are not geocoded.
Map viewport coordinates are not treated as office coordinates.
All narrative marketing paragraphs, job snippets and client-side count placeholders were excluded.
Taxonomy assignments describe published categorization and do not prove actual service availability.
